claims.assertion: Athena says incarnated partners are compatible variants of a shared higher consciousness, not necessarily a fixed exclusive pair; different variants may retain different past-life memories.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says attachments can sustain repetitive reincarnation loops; releasing them dissolves the loop, while unremembered lives may conceal its causes and constrain perceived agency.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
